_comment: signal_modulation/05_pilot_amp20 (2026-09-09): SETTLING PILOT for the 4-source design-05 reservoir - how fast do inversion and output reach the stationary state at pump 100? All four strips CW at amp 20 (mid-ladder: exercises pump-vs-stimulated, well under the ~80 ceiling), sensors armed from t=0 (dft_t_start 0) so pop_monitor records the N3 approach and snap_point (1Dsnap dt 20) the output y-line from the start. The measured settling time sets 05_ampsweep's dft_t_start (currently 3000; design01 with pump 50 settled by ~1200-2900 across its drive ladder, and worst case is at LOW drive - re-check at the ladder bottom if it looks marginal). gpumeep on lips F5-gpu via scripts/slurm_lips_run.sh.

crystal._comment: Nd:YAG gain, design-05 model: emission (stimulated 3->2) + pump only, NO rate_32. Scaled doping SGMA 1.86e-5 over 20 um -> same gL (3.72e-4*N3) as design04's literal doping over 600 um, so single-pass gain matches. Widened to 27.5 um so the four 4-um strips fit (design04's transverse layout).

source_1._comment: input strip 1, y=-10.3125 um, width 4 — CW for the amp sweep (all strips driven at the SAME level by single_source_sweep).

source_pump._comment: 808 nm CW pump from above, Ez, whole 20-um crystal top edge. Amp 100 (the 'set pump so stationary comes quickly' knob, 2026-09-09): with no rate_32 the pump is the recharge and its rate sets how fast the inversion reaches steady state.

snap_point._comment: output y-LINE time record (1Dsnap = line in y). The multi-strip output is y-dependent, so a single point misses the transverse profile; this records the whole output-guide y-line vs time. dt 20 (coarse on purpose) keeps storage modest for long/many runs — tune down toward the 1.064 carrier period (~1.06 t.u.) if you need the field phase rather than the envelope.

pop_monitor._comment: inversion vs time - THE key plot for this toy: N3 should be seen bleaching on each strong symbol and RECHARGING between them (tau_32 = 5000 t.u.), i.e. actually recovering within the run, which no prior design could show.

source_2._comment: input strip 2, y=-3.4375 um, width 4 — CW for the amp sweep (all strips driven at the SAME level by single_source_sweep).

source_3._comment: input strip 3, y=3.4375 um, width 4 — CW for the amp sweep (all strips driven at the SAME level by single_source_sweep).

source_4._comment: input strip 4, y=10.3125 um, width 4 — CW for the amp sweep (all strips driven at the SAME level by single_source_sweep).
